ns0:section.ns0:heading: Juvenile anti-drug and anti-gang grants in federally assisted low-income housing

ns0:content.ns0:p: Grants authorized in this Act to reduce or prevent juvenile drug and gang-related activity in “public housing” may be used for such purposes in federally assisted, low-income housing.

ns0:note.ns0:heading: References in Text
ns0:note.ns0:p: This Act, referred to in text, is Pub. L. 103–322, Sept. 13, 1994, 108 Stat. 1796, known as the Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act of 1994. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title of 1994 Act note set out under section 10101 of this title and Tables.

ns0:note.ns0:heading: Codification
ns0:note.ns0:p: Section was formerly classified to section 14061 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
